copy.curiosityHook: Caught between an estranged mother and a calculating girlfriend, which angle will pull him under first?
copy.description: In Stephen Frears's crime drama, a small-time conman finds his loyalties fractured between his estranged mother and his girlfriend, two high-stakes grifters operating with their own dangerous angles.
copy.vibeSummary: A deliberate, suspenseful neo-noir offering measured drama and steady tension built for focused solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Watch it for an engrossing, sharp-edged crime portrait where every gesture is calculated and familial ties offer no protection against high-stakes deceit.

allowedMaterial: Conflict between estranged mother and girlfriend
